name: Module1b

layout.switch_socket: Kailh CPG135001S30 SMT; Mill-Max not selected because individual through-hole sockets are not ordinary SMT assembly
layout.display: nice!view underside; factory soldered connector/module requires quote
layout.mount_change: M2 spacer centers shifted inward in X to avoid outer Choc socket pads/body; original module mounting-hole pattern is not retained

pcb.stackup_reference: Mikoto rev6.3 four-layer 7628 reference; JLC must confirm actual stack and RF impedance
notes: Inner copper layers are included in Gerber export
J1 has SMT signal pads and plated shell slots; supplier must confirm solder process
Minimum track uses verified 4-layer JLC 0.09mm capability; not the two-layer capability
Wuerth annular solder land intentionally meets its own NPTH per manufacturer drawing; scoped KiCad rule applies only within mounting footprints, and supplier must accept this land pattern.
USB shell land edge clearance is 0.225mm, above JLC routed-edge minimum 0.2mm; use routed edges, not V-scoring.

adaptation: USB-C, ESD protection and reset on keyboard PCB
BQ24075 power path and charger; XC6220 switched display rail
Four-layer PCB antenna geometry retained locally, host ground geometry changed
Charger 250mA/350mA selection resistor removed; fixed 8.66k ISET

battery.connector: JST PH2, J2 pad1 VBAT positive and pad2 GND negative; verify actual harness
battery.ts_behavior: Fixed 10k on TS bypasses cell-temperature monitoring; charger die thermal protection is not cell-temperature sensing
battery.mechanical_status: NOT VALIDATED: no unoccupied flush underside rectangle for this pack; requires insulated raised mounting below components, restraint, lead routing and clearance verification
battery.power_switch: VBAT throw asserts SYSOFF, disconnects battery and disables charging; USB can still power system. GND throw enables normal operation/charging

programming.bootloader: Mikoto-compatible nRF52840 bootloader is a reference only; supplier needs tested approved HEX/BIN. No new firmware implemented in this PCB-only task.
requirements: Verify 3.3V UICR REGOUT0 configuration before display use
Blank chip does not ship with USB flashing bootloader
Factory flash/readback and USB enumeration test required
Keyboard firmware must use the new pin map and P0.13 peripheral-power enable; original nice!nano binary cannot be assumed compatible
Final SWD image/hash and fixture/power procedure require approval

release_blockers: Prototype electrical bring-up: charging current, polarity, power switching, sleep current, USB and all keys/display
Insulated battery mounting and complete underside stack, including socket retention and insertion loads, are not physically validated
Factory acceptance and exact sourcing of nice!view/header assembly and M2 SMT spacers
Factory SWD bootloader image, fixture and programming/test service; application firmware not implemented
RF antenna tuning/range and actual JLC stackup; enlarged ground plane and USB route require verification
Crystal effective load/startup/frequency with retained reference capacitors; test with chosen parts
Live BOM availability, CPL origins/rotations, USB shell-slot soldering and first-article assembly review
